Bank of Baroda LBO Result 2025-26 Out

The Bank of Baroda has released the list of candidates provisionally placed in the Selected Category List and Wait List for the Local Bank Officer LBO JMGS I posts. The result has been published in PDF format with registration numbers arranged in ascending order for easy reference. A total of 2500 vacancies was announced under this recruitment drive. Candidates who find their registration number in the list are now eligible to move to the next phase of the selection process.

BOB LBO Final Result 2025-26 PDF

BOB Local Bank Officer final result has been released on 27th March 2026. All the candidates who appeared for the GD and Interview can check their qualifying status. The result is provisional merit list PDF showing registration numbers of candidates provisionally placed in the Selected Category List and Wait List. The list is state-wise and category-wise sorted making it easy for candidates to check their result status. Those who are selected will be called to present the documentary evidence that acknowledges their eligibility as per requirement. The DV round information will be sent to the registered email id of the selected candidates. The BOB LBO Result 2025-26 PDF is attached and candidates can directly download it from the link given below.

Download the BOB Local Bank Officer Final Result 2025-26 PDF

Here are the simple steps to download the BOB LBO Result 2025 PDF from the official website. Follow the instructions carefully to check whether you are provisionally selected and will be called for DV.

Download BOB LBO Final Result 2025-26 Notice PDF 

  • Visit the official Bank of Baroda Careers page
  • Find the section titled RECRUITMENT OF LOCAL BANK OFFICERS (LBOs) ON REGULAR BASIS IN BANK OF BARODA
  • Click on the link that says Declaration of Online Examination Result
  • Open the result PDF from the available link
  • Search for your Registration Number or Roll Number in the list and save the PDF for future use

Bank of Baroda LBO Document Verification

The Bank of Baroda LBO result has been announced after the selection process is finished. Some candidates are selected and some are on the waitlist. But the selection is only provisional, which means it is not final yet. Candidates must show all their original documents to prove they meet the eligibility rules given in the advertisement. If they cannot prove it, their selection can be cancelled by the bank.

Q1. Is the BOB LBO Result 2025 declared?
Ans. Yes, the Bank of Baroda LBO Final Result 2025-26 has been released on 27th March 2026, and candidates can download the result PDF online.

Q2. How can I check my Bank of Baroda LBO Result 2025-26?
Ans. You can check the BOB LBO Result by visiting the official website and downloading the PDF that lists registration numbers of shortlisted candidates.

Q3. What details are required to view the BOB LBO result 2026?
Ans. Candidates only need their Registration Number or Roll Number to search for their result in the PDF.
